latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of cohort-analysis-builder skill.

- Helps build, validate, and interpret cohort retention analyses for SaaS, e-commerce, and consumer products.
- Covers cohort definition types, appropriate cohort and retention time grains, and correct use of metrics (e.g., NRR, GRR, logo retention).
- Provides guidance on analyzing retention shapes (e.g., declining, flat, smile curve) and common pitfalls.
- Includes SQL patterns for constructing retention tables and highlights common implementation mistakes.
- Designed to trigger on requests related to cohort analysis in analytics tools and board/investor reporting contexts.
